title: L0182
description: A compiled L0182 survey: a named set of ideas someone is asked to choose between, and — once something has answered — the response to it, being the ideas chosen in priority order plus one new idea that was not in the set.

survey.description: The set of ideas and the bounds a response must satisfy. Written at code generation, resolved from the survey's name against the service that holds the pool.

name.description: The survey these ideas were drawn from. Ties a response back to the survey it answers, and is the argument code generation resolves the set from.

ideas.description: The set a response is chosen from. Not authored by hand: inlined at code generation from what the service returned.

minChoices.description: Fewest ideas a response may select. Enforced by the compiler, which is the only enforcement there is — nothing renders a survey interactively.

maxChoices.description: Most ideas a response may select. Never more than the number of ideas.

response.description: The answer to this survey. Absent until something answers. Written in code — by a person in the editor, or by an agent through update_item — so both clients produce the identical shape.

selection.description: The ids of the ideas chosen, in priority order. The order IS the ranking, first is most important. Empty when only a new idea was contributed. Source may name an idea by its id in quotes or by its position as a number; the compiler resolves positions, so compiled output is always ids.

idea.description: One new idea from whoever answered, which was not already in the set.

idea.title: Idea
idea.description: One idea in the set. The id is the service's own where the fetch returned one, and positional (i0 upward) where it did not — a selection names ids, never text.
